_about: The latest WCAG 3 Working Draft published at /TR/, as distinct from the editors' draft this site tracks. scripts/check-related-standards.mjs checks /TR/wcag-3.0/ weekly and reports when a newer draft appears; update this file by hand then (date, url, history, sinceThen).

highlights: Leveling moves from conformance to reporting: one conformance bar, wrapped in reporting tiers.
An alternative scoring-then-Bronze/Silver/Gold proposal is described, and W3C invites public comment on which approach to keep.
Every requirement and assertion at developing status is included; exploratory ones are left out.

sinceThen.summary: No change to provisions or the conformance section since publication. Later upstream commits are editorial (Explainer definitions), status resets and site tooling.
